question: For each academic year, list the academic year, academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0), and the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900. Present the results in the order of academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance,
    STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev,
    (SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(at2.DEGREE_YEAR))) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 WHERE at2.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900) AS geometric_mean_degree_year
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON t.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
WHERE t.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'
  AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
ORDER BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE), variance_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_stats), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), admin_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT
